note: Photo moments for ?moment=NAME (v2/sky.js). A time on Austin's clock and the numbers fitted to the owner's photo; no photo pixels and no place here. SKY: haze = aerosols (1 = optical depth 0.1 at 550 nm), ms = light scattered more than once (share of the sky's mean), sun = the sun's strength against the model's, cover = share of the sky under cloud. CAMERA (the photo's phone, not the light): exposure (1 = the default view's), wb = white balance gains (r, g, b), sat = saturation. Day exposure is fitted; sunset and night exposures follow from the photos' own exposure (shutter x ISO) against IMG_1778's.
